purpose: S072 angular current/coset matching and fixed-order transfer limitation

sources.reading_scope: Sections 3 (partial context) and 4.2, appendices A.1, A.2 and B coset-character subsection. Section 4.2 and both stress appendices read in full. Current algebra, stress/coset decomposition and branching are comparators. The present complex-fermion normalization and stress states are checked independently. No flat-space infrared gap or curved-RN equivalence is imported.

Introduction and section 2 preamble read in full. Operator decomposition, current primaries and branching guide the retained-state interpretation. The proposed full infrared theory, possible missing topological sectors, condensate mechanism and examples are not adopted for the wormhole.

Sections 2 and 3 read in full: affine algebra, null-state KZ derivation, four-point blocks and sewing constraints. Equation 3.4 uses a generator contraction twice the standard Cartesian spin dot product. The present norm bound is derived separately and does not import initial block coefficients.
